relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: In our cohort of refractory CCH, galcanezumab was effective in almost 50% of patients.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Calcitonin gene-related peptide has shown to play a central role in cluster headache (CH) pathophysiology.

key_findings: Galcanezumab reduced attack frequency in nearly half of refractory chronic cluster headache patients in real-world use.
